t: You're at Comyn Ching Triangle, a triangular block at the Seven Dials junction in Covent Garden. It's bounded by Monmouth, Mercer and Shelton Streets, with terraced buildings around a public space called Ching Court. The block was regenerated in the 1980s by Terry Farrell and Partners, and it's considered an exemplar of British postmodern architecture. Sir Terry Farrell was a British architect and urban designer, and this is one of his notable works in the area.
